gap: No result ChatGPT got states Apple's own mechanism: a strap never attaches to the iPhone itself. The connectors thread through small openings in the bottom corners of a compatible case, which you do with the case off the phone, so a strap only works with a case that has those holes or with an adapter that passes through the charging-port opening.
standout_why: I opened Camera Lookout (rank 11, 2026-10-20). It already says Apple 'names three iPhone 18 Pro case families that accept this strap', that OtterBox's strap 'attaches to OtterBox cases equipped with the relevant anchors', and that Peak Design's insert 'may block USB-C access while fitted'. So a rival already has the idea that the case has to provide the anchor. It does not say where that anchor is (holes in the bottom corners), that you fit it with the case off, or that the strap contains magnets, and it says nothing about MagSafe or wireless charging. WIRED (blocked to the fetcher), AppleInsider (HTTP 403) and the cited Bandolier page (HTTP 429 from both the fetcher and storecheck.py) could not be opened, so I could not compare against them.
decides: This confirms that the shopper should pick the case and the strap as a pair. Either buy a case with corner eyelets built in (Apple TechWoven or Silicone Case with MagSafe, or one of the rope-through-hole cases ChatGPT showed), or buy a case with a fully enclosed USB-C slot and add a pass-through adapter. A strap bought alone will not attach to a bare iPhone or to a case without those holes. The finding does not choose between the products ChatGPT showed.

findings.label: How the strap attaches
findings.value: Connectors thread through small openings in the case's bottom corners; the strap then snaps onto the connectors
findings.source_title: How to attach and adjust Crossbody Strap or Wrist Strap - Apple Support
findings.note: Apple's wording: 'Start with your case off of your iPhone.' 'Look for small openings on the bottom corners of your iPhone case where you can attach the Crossbody Strap connectors.' 'Thread the cord loop end of the connector from the outside of the case, through one of the openings in the case.' 'Use the snaps on Crossbody Strap to attach and detach it from the connectors on your iPhone case.' Page shows Published Date September 09, 2026.
